changelog: - **A Pool changed by a Value change before the moves is now drawn from at its changed level.** A Value change that runs before the moves (a label connection) sets or adjusts a Pool, but what other nodes could take from that Pool in the same step was still measured from the value the step began with. A Pool set from 1 down to 0.3 could still give 1, and the 0.7 it did not hold was made from nothing and reported nowhere; a Pool raised from 0 gave nothing of the raise until the next step. Now the level the Value change leaves is what can be taken in that step: an amount it removed cannot be taken, and an amount it added can. What a Source pushes into the Pool in the same step is still only available from the next step. In the bundled example `state-verification.json` the Tank Drain now drains at the first step, so the Tank holds 4 from the start instead of 8 then 4; no other bundled example changes. A Monte Carlo result saved before this change is shown as stale until it is run again (engine revision 19).
